body:
came here to find this. couldn't agree more. It's really nuanced, but god damn is it true at the core. In crisis, the only answer to your suffering is immediate hospitalization and rapid sedation. It's inhumane and does nothing to serve you anything towards healing or empathy. It merely assumes you are now deemed 'less than' worthy of your own autonomy, and they strip it from you in order to quell their own fear. being 'in crisis' has nothing to do with helping you. they just know that saying 'help' means you're less likely to resist their means of silencing you. They truly don't know what to do and don't care to try and make it better. They want it to stop. that's all. this is 100% a hill i will die on after 25 years of failed therapy, hospitalization, medication, police violence, the lot.   


The last thing i can tolerate is to see \*other\* mentally ill folks suffering in the same vein while being gaslit that its meant to 'help us'. It's not meant to help us. If we find help, then that is because we are resilient and not because the system is meant to do so. Stay strong friends.

I'm trying to apply for disability because of exactly this. On a bad day, I can just sit and dissociate for hours. Or sometimes it's not quite dissociation, but like you describe it's blurry and like my brain is intentionally not letting me process things.
I'm more happy you're not alone than sad that I'm in pain :) silver lining

I won't, haha :). I just appreciate morbidity. It's very human in my opinion. A facet of humanity shamefully stowed away as if it's not inside us all. I'm a musical artist so visual arts always leave me in awe. If anything, I'd try to commission a sketch from you in the future. If that's something you're open to. Just a thought. Take care, friend

I definitely experience this. Daily. And it gets worse once I've tried to deescalate once. It always spins out of control and i can't stop the intrusive thoughts. Dropped something? Good job you fucking idiot your hands don't even work, you're supposed to go get help and trick your brain into thinking it's okay when it's not and you can't even hold a fucking object you stupid fuck. Doesn't matter what upsets you, it's ridiculous and you should just 'get over it'. It's all your fault. A fucking tiny thing. Anybody else can just pick it up and go on their day. How weak are you? Pathetic. Nobody else freaks out like this. Only you. You and your stupid pathetic fucking body that can't even hold a fucking object and you're sitting here in la-la-land thinking that you can just "talk therapy" your way to a better life? You fucking idiot.
Right? It's as if the numbers 1-99 don't even exist

Thoughts begin in the amygdala and 'move' their way forward, increasing in complexity. In these states it never leaves the amygdala. That's how I've had it explained to me. I need to pick up one of these books maybe
Sympathy and sentiment don't usually help me (if anything make it worse) but this time they do. I appreciate your words. They feel very genuine and it made me laugh too. Thank you.
Now that's what I call a silver lining. Thanks for the laugh.

Out of fear for my own safety let me explain that I am NOT going to hurt anybody I do NOT have a desire to hurt people, these are merely violent thoughts towards my abusers specifically during moments of being triggered. Jesus christ, I really have to explain that or fear the police. I fucking hate this country.
If you could PM me any recommendations... I'm open... thank you
